Hi Nathan,

It would be great to find out the error message clang gives when it
exits prematurely. Could you try compiling the problematic model with
`verbose=True` (i.e., `StanModel(model_code = simple_model2,
verbose=True)`) and, assuming there's some intelligible error message,
copy and paste that into a Github issue for PyStan at
https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan/issues ?

Thanks,

Allen
